tasks.title: (Practical)
tasks.statement:
A mixture of metallic iron with freshly prepared iron (II) and iron (III) oxides was
heated in a closed vessel in the atmosphere of hydrogen. An amount of 4.72 g of the
mixture when reacted, yields 3.92 g of iron and 0.90 g of water.
     When the same amount of the mixture was allowed to react with an excess of a
copper(II) sulphate solution, 4.96 g of a solid mixture were obtained.

2.1 Calculate the amount of 7.3 % hydrochloric acid (ρ = 1.03 g cm-3) which is needed for a
     total dissolution of 4.72 g of the starting mixture.
2.2 What volume of a gas at STP is released?
